alt: 奶奶笑著端來一盤地瓜，男孩一手舉掌客氣推辭，另一手卻朝盤子伸去，嘴角露出期待；媽媽在旁微笑看著。
scene_prompt: 半推半就：採『心裡願意，表面卻假意推辭』。重點是嘴上客氣推讓，身體已準備接受。台灣家庭餐桌旁，奶奶把一盤孩子最喜歡的地瓜點心遞向男孩，男孩一手輕輕擺掌作客氣推讓，另一手卻已伸近盤邊，眼神期待地看著點心，嘴角藏著笑。媽媽在旁溫柔看穿他的心意，奶奶繼續親切邀請。對話不用文字，靠表情與動作矛盾呈現，不畫真正害怕拒絕或強迫取食。手指不碰熱食，盤子有穩定支撐，每手五指，全圖無文字數字字母及類字形符號，橫向三比二，1536×1024。
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website for elementary students in Taiwan. Landscape 3:2. Setting: present-day Taiwan (Taiwanese schools, streets, homes, parks). Taiwanese school uniform = plain polo shirt or white shirt with shorts/skirt, or sports PE uniform; NO red neckerchief, NO red scarf. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, paper texture visible. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy brown, generous ivory breathing room; no bright flat digital colors, no glossy 3D, no imitation of a named artist. Every person has five fingers per hand, arms clearly attached to shoulders, feet grounded and pointing naturally.
